title: agrostis capillaris var. glaucina
intro: Agrostis capillaris var. glaucina, commonly known as Red Top Bentgrass, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family (Poaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, including reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Red Top Bentgrass include expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help relieve coughs and soothe irritated tissues. Its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
